My name is Khánh (pronunciation), and I also roll with Kan, or Khanh, or Khan.
I am currently a first year Master student in CS at EPFL.
Previously I worked as SWE-SRE at Google, on network system’s reliability. My Bachelor in Mathematics & CS was at École polytechnique.
My hobbies include photography (1, 2), cooking, blogging, bouldering and many more.
In my distant past life, I did competitive programming and got some memorable achievements.
You can reach me at khanhn1462 (at) gmail (dot) com.
